patterns: ^On hold: this session has spent its (\$[\d.,]+) limit\. Raise it in Usage to go on\.$
已暂停：这个会话已花到 $1 的上限。在用量面板里调高上限即可继续。
^On hold: Jarvis Code has spent today's (\$[\d.,]+) limit\. Raise it in Usage, or it goes on tomorrow\.$
已暂停：Jarvis Code 今天已花到 $1 的上限。在用量面板里调高上限，或者明天继续。
^On hold: (.+) has spent its (\$[\d.,]+) limit for today\. Raise it in Usage, or it goes on tomorrow\.$
已暂停：$1 今天已花到 $2 的上限。在用量面板里调高上限，或者明天继续。
^Stopped: Jarvis Code has spent today's (\$[\d.,]+) limit\.$
已停止：Jarvis Code 今天已花到 $1 的上限。
^Stopped: (.+) has spent its (\$[\d.,]+) limit for today\.$
